name: Jim Coleman Wholesale Parts
old_description: At Jim Coleman Automotive, we only stock parts and accessories that meet the highest standards of quality and compatibility for your vehicle. From routine maintenance to more specific repairs, we have the parts you need. And if we don’t have it, we’ll order it for you and get it to you as quickly as possible!
about:
Jim Coleman Wholesale Parts operates from Bethesda, Maryland, as the parts division of Jim Coleman Automotive, a dealership group the Coleman family founded in 1952. The business began as a single dealership and has grown to serve the Greater Washington, D.C. area from locations in Bethesda, Silver Spring, Clarksville, and Ellicott City, remaining family-owned throughout its history.

The division distributes OEM parts and accessories for multiple vehicle brands to both retail customers and professional shops. It runs a dedicated wholesale program that integrates with OPSTrax, PartsTrader, CollisionLink, and CCCIS ordering platforms, allowing body shops and repair facilities to place orders online, by phone, email, or fax. The company stocks a range of maintenance items — wiper blades, floor mats, cargo nets, and cargo mats — and carries OEM tires from Michelin, Bridgestone, Goodyear, Dunlop, and other major brands. Delivery is offered same-day or next-day within the region, and a 30-day return window applies to most parts.

Primary customers include collision centers, mechanical repair shops, and fleet operators throughout the D.C., Maryland, and Virginia corridor, as well as walk-in retail buyers. The wholesale program is structured specifically for body shops, with free access to the major estimating and ordering systems used in the collision-repair workflow.

The company emphasizes its legacy of community roots and service-first approach, positioning the wholesale parts operation as an extension of the dealership group's long-standing commitment to the region rather than a standalone parts house.
